en.title: Bitcoin Posts Strongest August in Nine Years, Setting Up Q4
slides: Bitcoin is closing out its strongest August performance in nine years.
Historical data shows August is often a quiet month, making this rally notable.
Strong August gains have historically aligned with bullish fourth quarter trends.
Traders now turn their attention to what September and Q4 could bring.
en.caption:
Bitcoin is on pace to record its strongest August in nine years, according to U.Today. The monthly gain stands out because August is historically a quieter month for price action. Past strong Augusts have often coincided with bullish fourth quarter performance, a pattern analysts are now watching closely.
